parameters.query: SELECT o.*, ARRAY(SELECT termo FROM termos_hot_agora WHERE o.titulo ILIKE '%' || termo || '%' LIMIT 5) as termos_hot_match, COALESCE((SELECT boost_score FROM performance_categoria WHERE categoria = o.categoria LIMIT 1), 0) as boost_categoria FROM ofertas_coletadas o WHERE o.coletado_em > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND (o.score_total IS NULL OR o.score_total = 0) LIMIT 50
UPDATE ofertas_coletadas SET score_total = {{ $json.score_total }}, score_breakdown = '{{ $json.breakdown_json }}'::jsonb, scoreado_em = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}

meta.description: Motor de qualidade. Calcula score 0-100 pra cada oferta combinando 6 fatores: desconto real (Zoom), fonte, freshness, comissao, urgencia, categoria-hot. Sem esse workflow, o poster nao sabe o que priorizar.
